Words.Text: Welcome to the world of Mu.;We have been waiting for a hero like you to arrive and put a stop to the chaos brought on to the Mu realm by Kundun.
Continue listening.
However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?
A tutorial?;I look forward to it!
Tutorials are for children. Turn down the offer.
It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?
I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!
How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!
I'm glad we can help. We aren't difficult to find.;Simply look for and talk to the Shadow Phantom Soldier in any of the towns.
I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.
I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.
...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!
...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?
Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.
Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the queen of Noria.
...Shadow Phantom?;Guardians of the queen?
What are the queen's guardians doing at a place like this?
The queen's orders are to help those warriors starting out on their journey so that they can at least defend themselves against the forces of Kundun.
...I'm moved that the queen has made such orders.
How will you help, exactly?
I will teach you basic hunting and controls through a simple tutorial.;It's not that difficult, and I'm sure you'll finish it in no time.
Great! I'll finish this tutorial in no time!
Excellent! Let's get started with the tutorial.
Let's start with something simple.;Close your quest window and either press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.
Did you launch the Character Stats window?;That window contains the character's name and level, the name of the current server, and character statuses.
...There's nothing to it. But I would like to learn more....
Can you explain in more detail?
We have much to cover. Let's move on to the next step.
I'll explain this in more detail. What else do you wish to know?
...I wish to learn about...
EXP Points and Leveling Up
Character and Server Selection
Points and Status

Gain EXP points to level up.;You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.;The bar is divided into ten segments, and filling them up will elevate you to the next level.
...Is that right? And then I'd like to learn about...
Character and Server Selection
Points and Status
You've explained enough. Let's continue with the tutorial.

The Character Stats window will tell you the name of your character, the name of the current server, and your character's class. It's possible to connect to different channels within a single server using the same character.;There are four basic character classes: the Elf, the Dark Knight, the Dark Wizard, and the Summoner. Reach level 220 with any of these basic characters to unlock the Magic Gladiator, and level 250 to unlock the Dark Lord.

Leveling up will earn you points. These points can be used to enhance your strength, agility, stamina, and energy and thereby affect your damage, defense, HP, and MP levels, respectively.;Carefully use these points, for how you develop your character will determine its combat characteristics and the types of weapons and skills it can use.
Now, press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.

The Inventory window will display the items you have and the equipments you are wearing.;Click on an item to change its position or, if it's a consumable, right-click on it to use it. Did you get all that?
Of course I did.
Quick, on to the next step!
You are full of zeal! Very well. Let's try adding an item to your inventory. Take the Zen I just gave you and purchase 5 apples from a merchant.
Finally, a quest! You want me to buy 5 apples from a merchant?
Excellent! I will be back in a flash.
Where can I find a merchant?

Apples can be purchased from potion merchants. In Lorencia, look for Potion Girl Amy, who is located across the bridge (128,85). In Elveland, look for Silvia, who is in the 1 o'clock direction from the center of the square (45,227). In Noria, look for Elf Lala, who is slightly to the north from the town's center (172,124).
...Finding a merchant is more difficult than I thought.
How do I check coordinates?
The character's current coordinates are shown on the top left corner of the screen. Movement in the ↖ or ↘ direction changes the first number, and movement in the ↗ or ↙ direction the second.
It's possible to find out the location of myself and others using coordinates? Amazing!
Loud and clear! Give me the next quest!
Go find the merchant in town and bring back 5 apples.;The NPC's name will be shown in light blue, and the point symbol will turn into a tooth symbol when you scroll over it with your mouse.

Look at the right side of your screen. Do you see the apples you just bought? Adding a potion to the Inventory will automatically register it.;Press the Q button to use apples, potions, and other HP recovery items and the W button to use MP recovery items.
Whoa! That's really convenient!
Continue the conversation.
Since you now have potions, would you like to leave the safe zone and do some real hunting? Are you ready?
Great! I finally get the chance to show off what I can do.
Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?
Explain potions to me once more.
Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 3 Chain Scorpions.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 3 Budge Dragons.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.

I see you've successfully completed your first hunt! Did you find it difficult? Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.;You can pick up items dropped by defeated monsters using the mouse or automatically by pressing the space bar.
Did you say the space bar?
That will surely make things easier. Do you have any other tips?
I already knew that. What's the next quest?
Also, if you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy. Are you familiar with using it?
...Town Portal Scroll?
What is this Town Portal Scroll?
Of course I know. What's the next quest?

Town Portal Scrolls can be purchased from potion merchants in towns. They are single-use items that will bring you back to the last town you visited.;Since we're on the subject, will you go and purchase a Town Portal Scroll from the merchant? It'll be easier to understand if you try it for yourself.
...Hmm. I didn't know such thing existed.
Very well. How many do I need to buy?
Go see the potion merchant again and buy just 1 Town Portal Scroll.
You've done well. Let's see to one more thing before I ask you to face tougher monsters. Talk to me again and receive a damage and defense increase buff.
A damage and defense increase buff? That sounds great!
How do I get it?

Close the Quest window and click on me again. After that, select 'Receive damage and defense increase buff.' This buff is available to anyone under level 220.;After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.
Excellent! It's time for the next quest. Since you are now familiar with hunting, let's get you to go after a tougher monster.
Just say the word!
Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?
Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 30 Beetle Monsters. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 30 Hounds. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 30 Polluted Butterflies. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
I see you've now mastered hunting. When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.
...Skill attacks?
Where can I learn skills?
This is common knowledge.
If you are an Agility Elf, whose priority is defense, you can equip a weapon and use its skills. If you are an Energy Elf, whose priority is wizardry, you can purchase orbs to learn skills.
...How do I do it?
I want to be an Elf who focuses on defense!
I want to be an Elf who focuses on wizardry!
I don't want to decide right now. Just describe them for me.

So you've decided to become an Agility Elf, a class for whom defense is crucial. Agility Elves are unique in that they employ splendid bow skills. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.

So you've decided to become an Energy Elf, a class for whom wizardry is crucial. Energy Elves are unique in that they employ a variety of summoning and magic spells. Let me give you an orb as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.
Dark Knights are unique in that they are powerful swordsmen who rely on both weapons and orbs. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.
Dark Wizards are unique in that they are capable of mastering various magic spells from scrolls and parchments. Let me give you a scroll as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.
Summoners are unique in that they are capable of mastering various magic spells from scrolls and parchments. Let me give you a scroll as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.
The weapon I gave you is a crossbow. To equip it, load the crossbow item to the equipment slot in your Inventory. Go ahead and equip it.
The orb I gave you will teach you the Summon Goblin skill. Right-click on the item to learn the skill. Go ahead and learn the skill.
The weapon I gave you is a Double Axe. To equip it, load the Double Axe item to the equipment slot in your Inventory. Go ahead and equip it.
The scroll I gave you will teach you the Fire Ball skill. Right-click on the item to learn the skill. Go ahead and learn the skill.

If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.

After learning a skill from an orb, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.

...The icon next to the number 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 slots....
I got it!

I learned a skill!
Where can I learn more skills?
Elves can learn additional skills by going to Noria and purchasing orbs from Elf Lala (173,124) or weapons from Eo the Craftsman (195,123).
Dark Knights can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing orbs from Pasi the Mage (119,112). After purchasing an orb, right-click on it to learn the skill.
Dark Wizards can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing scrolls from Pasi the Mage (119,112) or weapons from Hanzo the Blacksmith (116,142).
Summoners can learn additional skills by going to Elveland and purchasing scrolls from Marce (36,218). After purchasing a scroll, right-click on it to learn the skill.
...I see it pays to know a lot of NPCs.
I understand well. What's the next quest?

We're nearing the end of our tutorial. Now that you have a skill, it'll make sense for you to build more combat experience. Come back when you reach a certain level, and I will give you a Uniria as a reward.
What's a Uniria?
What level do I need to be?
Uniria is a mount item you can use out in the battle field. Equip it to the top left corner of your Inventory window for faster travel throughout the battle field.
...That's fantastic!
What level do I need to be?
Come back once you've reached level 25.;I will then reward you with a Uniria as a gift.
You've truly become a fine warrior. I'm sure the queen herself will be proud of you. Truth be told, she has arranged a few items for warriors such as you.
...The queen is very thoughtful!
Continue listening.
I will give you the queen's gifts if you pass a test to see if there's anything else you need to know and if you have the basic knowledge to travel throughout the MU realm. How about it?
Hmm...a test...
Excellent! Bring on the test!
I'd rather you give me the gifts without the test.
The test is simple enough, and it won't matter if you don't get everything right. If you do, however, there's a small bonus gift.;Are you sure you don't want to take the test?
...A bonus gift if I answer all the questions right?
Excellent! Bring on the test!
I'll just take the queen's gifts without taking the test.
Here's your first question.;How do you trade with a character that's in front of you?
Press D and select Trade or type in '/trade' in the Chat window.
Press D and select Trade or type in '/exchange' in the Chat window.
Press D and select Trade or type in '/invite' in the Chat window.
That is correct! Pressing D will give you access to various commands, including Trade, Party, Buy, and Follow. Use these commands well.
Ah, you've answered incorrectly. To trade, press D and select Trade or face the character and type in '/trade' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.
When you want to form a party with a character, face that character and enter '/party' in the Chat window. What do you do if you don't want to receive party requests?
Party request?
Type in '/off' in the Chat window.
Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window.
Type in '/Party off' in the Chat window.

That is correct! If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in '/Request off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window.

Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window to turn down party requests. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.
Whispers are used to talk to friends who are far away or to pass on private messages. Which button is used to send whispers from the Chat window?
From the Chat window, use the Shift button.
From the Chat window, use the Ctrl button.
From the Chat window, use the Tab button.
That is correct! When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.

Ah, you've answered incorrectly. When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.

You'll need to regularly repair your equipments since their durability will diminish as you hunt monsters. When you reach a certain level, you will be able to repair your equipments directly from the Inventory window. What level is that?
Too easy! To repair equipment without the help of an NPC, I need to be at...
Level 30
Level 50
Level 75
That is correct! You can have your equipment repaired by Hanzo the Blacksmith (117,140) in Lorencia, Rhea (30, 235) in Elveland, or Eo the Craftsman (194, 123) in Noria. Solicit their services often.

Ah, you've answered incorrectly.; You'll be able to repair your equipment with ease by using the Repair button from the Inventory window once you reach level 50. However, this is more costly than repairing through an NPC.;Let's move on to the next question.

The higher the level, the more distance you get to travel. Using the M button, however, it's possible to travel to distant areas in a flash. What is the minimum level you need to be and the amount of Zen you need in order to enter the Dungeon?
Hmm...First, press M and then...
Level 10 and 2,000 Zens
Level 30 and 3000 Zens
Level 50 and 4000 Zens

That is correct! In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination.;Discovering areas that's right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.

Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Use M to find out and travel to accessible areas with ease. Discovering areas that are right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.;On to the next question.

In MU, it's possible to combine different items to create new ones. In fact, trying out different combinations of items adds a whole new dimension to MU.;Whom should you seek out in order to combine items?
The answer is obvious!
The Goblin NPC in Noria.
The Seed Master NPC in Elveland.
The Trainer NPC in Lorencia.
That is correct! With the help of NPCs in the towns, you can not only combine items, but also enhance your armor by adding jewels to it and much more. Make sure to visit them all.

Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Take the items, ingredients, and the money you need for combining to the Goblin in Noria to create a new item. Make sure to try it at least once. Let's skip to the next question.
Congratulations. You've completed the tutorial. Take this Ring of Hero and this Ring of Warrior. They are gifts to you from the queen.
...Finally, the tutorial's finished!
Ring of Hero? Ring of Warrior? What are they?
Thank you!

Ah, I'll have to go far back in time to explain that.;Runedil, the former queen of Elves, was saddened by the loss of all the new warriors of the MU empire, who gave up their lives to constant warring.
Continue listening.
So she imbued rings with the power of the Elves and gave them to warriors in honor of Muren's practice of handing out warriors' rings bearing the emperor's crest.
Continue listening.
That custom all but disappeared when peace finally came. However, Kundun and the chaos he brought motivated Erin Gustiv, the reigning queen of the Elves, to reinstate it.
Ah. So that's what happened....
Continue listening.
When a warrior who possesses them becomes a consummate expert in his or her art, these rings transform into unique items that will help their master attain greater heights.
Oh! That will surely come in handy!
Take the rings.

You'll be able to use the Ring of Hero at level 40 and the Ring of Warrior at level 80. Dropping the rings will break their seal and transform them into items.;Next time we meet, I sincerely hope to see a mightier warrior before me. Go now and build your experience and strength and free this world from Kundun's grasp!;(You've completed the tutorial.)

Gens Duprian is a guild of the greatest heroes in Arca and at its heart is the Duprian clan, the mightiest noble bloodline in MU. We are led by Duprian Winston, a knight who knows no equal in the whole of the MU empire.
Go back.

Gens dispute…? Gens Vanert’s rebellion is more like it. The gens dispute started because of the greed of Vanert Reicht, the commanding knight of Gens Vanert. Exactly five years ago, a band of heroes who were searching in La Cleon for a stone with the power to seal away Kundun were slaughtered. At the time, we believed it was the work of Selupan, a giant spider and the ruler of La Cleon, but soon learned that it was actually Gens Vanert. It is the duty of our proud Gens Duprian champions to retaliate and fight.
Oh! You wish to become a member of Gens Duprian? Share our virtues of honor and respect, and help in the fight to crush the greed of Gens Vanert and find the stone that will seal away Kundun.
Yes. I wish to join.

Devil Square is the place where the Elf Tree once stood. The Elf Tree was created by the mother of all Elves, an underground Elf known as Aria. This tree had the ability to produce Elves regularly. Then Secrarium tricked Lugard and appeared in Noria, at the location of the Elf Tree.

Having set his eyes on the tree's power of birth, Secrarium corrupted the Elf Tree and transformed it into an Immoral Tree that gave birth to monsters. The monsters horde grew to astronomical proportions, and the kingdoms of the MU continent combined their forces to entrap the immoral tree in a space of nothingness.

Monsters, however, continued to spawn at regular intervals from the spot where the tree once stood. After careful consideration, the queen of the Elves decided to make a training arena of this place for travelers.

Due to Lev's illusion spells, however, the souls of the dead followers remained in this world to defend the temple. These souls believed Lev's return would allow them to reclaim their bodies and continued to safeguard the temple. Today, the temple is guarded by the alliance in case Lev does actually return and Illusion Sorcery uses ancient relics to lure in unsuspecting travelers to their cause.
I see. How do I enter?

It's very easy to enter Illusion Temple. It can be entered every four hours from 01:00 a.m. and on: 01:00 a.m., 05:00 a.m., 09:00 a.m., 01:00 p.m., 05:00 p.m., and 09:00 p.m. To enter, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before an Illusion Temple event commences and ask to join. Mirage will then send you to the temple.
It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?

Upon entering, you'll need to wait for other players to enter. The players will then be divided into two teams: Alliance Camp and Illusion Sorcery Camp. The camp that brings over more relics to their own side wins.
Is there anything I should be aware of about Illusion Temple?

You'll not be able to use certain skills like Teleport or Telekinesis while holding on to a relic. On the other hand, there are special skills that can only be used in Illusion Temple. Using these skills to your advantage will make it easier for your camp to win.

There are a number of ways you can prove your worth on the continent of MU. You can try to be the last one standing in Chaos Castle, or work with your comrades to battle through Blood Castle, Devil Square, or Illusion Temple. Travelers regard such feats as some of the worthiest accomplishments one can achieve.
So it's not just about equipment or level.

That's right. You do need good equipment and a high level to test your mettle against other travelers, yes. But just that isn't enough for you to become a hero of MU. I will help you receive recognition as a hero by giving you a series of missions. You may repeat these missions as often as desired.
Recognition as a hero...

Sure! What's this simple mission about? (Accept)

I'm sorry to hear that. There are many ways to become stronger, but they'll all take time. Remember that well.

You have accepted the first trial. 어떤 방법이죠?
부자들에게 골동품을 팔아 한 밑천 잡는거에요. 모험가들에게는 볼품 없는 돌조각이지만, 부자들에겐 예술적가치가 있다나? 부자들이란... 그덕에 내가 돈을 버는 거지만요. 저를 도와주시면 그 창고를 사용할 수 있도록 도움을 드릴게요.
제가 어떻게 도와 드리면 되죠?
새 창고에 공간을 하나더 분양해 줄테니, 고대의 조각상을 나에게 가져다 주지 않겠어요? (50레벨 이상 캐릭터)
알겠습니다. (수락)
지금은 바빠서 도와드릴 수가 없군요. (거절)
아쉽네요. 그래도 창고를 넓히고 싶으시다면 다시 찾아와 주세요.(퀘스트가 취소 되었습니다.)
로스트타워 7층에서 데쓰 나이트에게서 고대의 조각상을 얻을 수 있을 거에요. 그 고대의 조각상을 가져오면, 새로운 창고를 하나 분양해 드릴게요. 창고의 사용 권한은 재접속 이후부터 가능합니다.
늘 사용하는 배낭이 무엇으로 만들어진 줄 아십니까? 바로 마법의 옷감이지요. 그래서 모든 모험가들이 무거운 장비를 여러 개 가지고 다녀도 괜찮은 거죠. 보급품으로 누구나 들고 다녀서 그렇지 실은 매우 귀한거랍니다. 실은 제가 제안하고 싶은 거래가 있는데….

What is the free mercenary?

Free mercenary doesn't really belong to the mercenary guild; anybody can receive a request and get the reward only if he or she has certain sum of money for registration. We take the deposit for each request, but it's fully refundable as you finish the request. Don't you worry. We request you what you can handle.
